acceptanceCriteria: A merge_group run of ci.yml whose commit's tree a completed successful pull_request run of this workflow already tested in full (records for every shard of the current count) skips only the root Go race invocation and retains the ci-reuse decision with the reused run id; any mismatch, listing failure, failed, partial, narrowed or differently-sharded run stays FULL.

AFP-V0-026 is amended and a new AFP-V0 requirement records the queue reuse with its limits; tools/ci-reuse-plan tests cover the admitted merge_group case and each refusal; the workflow shard-count test still binds REUSE_SHARDS to the matrix.
One hosted merge_group run after the change is retained showing REUSE with the pull-request run id, or the first observation is recorded as NOT_OBSERVED with the reason.
body: Owner request 2026-10-13: PRs wait serially because every merge runs the full 8-shard race matrix three times (pull_request run ~25 min, merge_group run ~20 min, main push ~9-20 min), and the beamfall org is on the free plan (20 concurrent hosted jobs; one CI run holds 13), so raising the ruleset's max_entries_to_build cannot add parallelism until per-run cost drops. AFP-V0-024 already lets a main push reuse a passed pull_request run of the identical tree; AFP-V0-026 keeps the merge_group run FULL and reuse off for it. When the queue entry is the first on an unmoved main, the queue commit is merge(main, PR head) with the same two parents as the pull-request merge ref the PR run tested, so the trees are identical by construction and the identity binds the workflow file, the Go pin and every tracked path. Expected: the merge_group run's docs-plan reuse step runs for merge_group too, admits only a completed successful pull_request run of ci.yml whose head_sha is the queue commit's second parent and that retained ci-tested-tree-TREE-full-S-of-N records for every shard with TREE = the queue commit's tree; then the race invocation is omitted (static, interop, doc, artifact checks still run, go-product aggregates as in REUSE). A later entry whose tree includes a preceding entry differs and runs FULL. Pairs with V1-0760 (the main push reuses the queue run of the same commit, which needs merge_group shards to write the tested-tree record). Limit: AFP-V0-029 shadow rows (V1-0811) must take a REUSE queue run's outcomes from the reused pull_request run.
title: ci: a merge-queue run reuses the identical-tree pull-request result instead of repeating the race shards
